_note: exp-016: twelve-arm decomposition_report_card coverage re-score (Refs #40). Additive-only re-score from each arm's already-committed results.json against ADR 0007's pinned 600. No new generation. CPU-only, no GPU, no runs/run.lock taken.
eval_set: MuSiQue ADR 0007 pinned 600 (200/hop), verified per-arm via each arm's own generation-time metrics.json.evaluation_set (pinned=true, ids_missing_count=0, ids_unexpected_count=0, rows_loaded_per_hop={2:200,3:200,4:200}) on all 12 arms

additive_reproduction_check.method: every arm's pre-existing metric keys (step_f1_macro, ordered_step_accuracy_macro, hop_count_exact_match_rate, composite_score, exact_match_rate, rouge_l_f1_macro, plus the PR#44 Break-faithful columns break_exact_match_rate/sari_macro/ged_macro/chain_validity_macro and the PR#48 over/under-decomposition rates where the prior file already had them) compared byte-for-byte against the arm's most recent prior committed eval_metrics.json (exp-011 for the 9 exp-004/005/008/009 arms, exp-012's own eval/{router_guided,unguided_rescored,oracle_guided_rescored} for the 3 exp-012 arms)
new_columns_added_by_this_run: decomp_mean_macro (for the 3 exp-012 arms, which predate PR#48; the 9 exp-011 arms already had decomp_mean_macro since exp-011 postdates PR#44 but predates PR#48's naming/status stamp)

note_on_exp012_reused_predictions: exp012_unguided_rescored and exp012_oracle_guided_rescored score the EXACT SAME results.json files as exp004_unguided and exp004_oracle_guided (exp-012's own row: 'reuses exp-004's already-committed unguided and oracle_guided arms'). Their report-card values are therefore expected to be, and are, byte-identical to exp004_unguided / exp004_oracle_guided. This is coverage bookkeeping (exp-012's per-item files, scored at c69ef5f before the suite existed, now carry it too), not a new measurement.

decomposition_report_card.name: decomposition_report_card
decomposition_report_card.shape: an UNBLENDED suite of six terms — there is no composite over them
decomposition_report_card.denominator: every term is a macro mean over the evaluated items; no term is a ratio pooled across items, and no denominator depends on what the model emitted

terms.prices: whole-plan verbatim identity of the '@@SEP@@'-joined string, lowercased
n-gram edit quality vs the question: kept-F1, added-F1, deleted-precision, n = 1..4
one distance over wording (node substitution), chaining (edges) and step count (node insertion/deletion)
terms.provenance: literature: Break official normalized graph edit distance

terms.prices: did the plan chain where the gold requires chaining, and do its '#k' resolve backwards
terms.provenance: house repair, not a published metric (PR #44 / ADR 0026)

terms.prices: granularity: the right number of steps
a length error in the direction the supervisor judged NOT tolerable (ADR 0017)
a length error in the direction the supervisor judged tolerable (ADR 0017)

decomposition_report_card.paired_terms_rule: Terms 6a and 6b (under_decomposition_rate, over_decomposition_rate) are reported as a PAIR and never summed: ADR 0017 records that over-decomposition is tolerable and under-decomposition is not, and summing them would erase exactly that. step_count_exact_rate is 1 - the two of them and is reported separately.
reporting_rules: All six terms are always reported together, with their direction. A note or table that quotes fewer than six is not reporting this metric.

Every comparison carries the ADR 0009 battery PER TERM (paired bootstrap CI, paired t-test, and McNemar for the binary terms 1, 5 and 6). Every term has a per-item value, so the legacy composite's 1-of-3-tests weakness does not apply to any of them.
Report per gold hop depth as well as overall (per_gold_hop_metrics carries the whole block).

Report a junk-baseline block beside the arms — Break prints its own 'Copy' baseline in its results table. The battery is scripts/decomposition_junk_battery.py, and its acceptance criteria are tests in tests/test_decomposition_metrics.py.
Composite terms with model-dependent denominators are forbidden in the headline; reference_validity_micro is the instance that motivated the rule.

single_number_when_one_is_required.why_a_member_and_not_a_formula: the field's own precedent for a single number is one member of the family made stricter (Break/QDMR's NormEM) or one strict column selected on (EntailmentBank), never a blend over the family
caveats: LOWER IS BETTER - it is a distance, where terms 1, 2, 4 and 5 are scores; the only other lower-is-better terms are the two length-error rates of term 6.
It is order-light, and on a 2-step plan order-BLIND (a reversed gold can score better than a real arm), which is why terms 1, 5 and 6 must stay reported beside it.

Absolute values are NOT comparable to published Break GED: this port has no spaCy lemmatizer in the node substitution cost (ADR 0026 item 3), and it scores against MuSiQue gold rather than QDMR annotations.

contingency_blend.formula: per item, the unweighted mean over the components of: break_exact_match, sari, 1 - min(ged_clamp, ged), chain_validity, hop_count_exact_match
contingency_blend.weights: all equal by construction; there is no weighted variant
contingency_blend.status: CONTINGENCY, not part of the reported suite. Offered only against a requirement for one blended number, reported beside the suite and never instead of it
contingency_blend.junk_gate: GATE PASSED on the ADR 0007 pinned 600 (all 15 rows on the same 600 items): the best junk baseline scored decomp_mean 0.1412 (J4, three fixed steps) against a real-arm worst of 0.5085 (exp005 unguided / unguided_capped), a margin of +0.3673, and every one of J1-J4 ranked below every one of the nine committed arms. Re-derive with scripts/decomposition_junk_battery.py; the table is in ADR 0029.

terms_excluded_and_why.reference_validity_micro: a ratio pooled across items whose denominator is produced by the model: on five of seven committed arms it was empty and scored 1.0 by rule, and on the other two, 2 of 600 items owned the whole denominator (issue #40)
terms_excluded_and_why.composite_score: an aggregate-of-aggregates with no per-item value, so it takes 1 of the 3 tests in the ADR 0009 battery; it is frozen as legacy and reported separately

decomposition_report_card.adoption: NOT ADOPTED HERE. Whether this suite (or any part of it) becomes the THESIS-primary metric is issue #6 item 5 — Jahid's decision with his supervisor. This script specifies and reports; it does not adopt

legacy_composite.why_it_is_still_computed: frozen byte-identical so nine committed arms, exp-010's 33 sweep cells and both v1 re-analysis notes stay valid and quotable — for reproducibility, not because the term is correct
